page_title: LAZ 1-0 FIO | Lazio v Fiorentina 30/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ciro Immobile (Lazio) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Pietro Terracciano no chance!
90+5' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' The players claim that Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Lazio are about to take a penalty!
90+1' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) tries to find Ciro Immobile, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Ivan Provedel.
89' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
87' The ball rebounds to Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the right post.
86' The foul by Pedro (Lazio) was seen by Matteo Marcenaro who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

85' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) wins himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. The shot goes towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel makes a decent save and thwarts the effort.
85' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
83' What a chance that is! Matias Vecino (Lazio) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
81' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
79' Substitution. Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) replaces Cristiano Biraghi.
78' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ciro Immobile (Lazio) replacing Taty Castellanos.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Pedro (Lazio) coming on for Mattia Zaccagni.

77' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
76' Corner kick. Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.
76' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
75' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
73' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
71' Here is a change. Arthur Melo is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina).
70' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
70' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
67' Today's match ends for Matteo Guendouzi who will be replaced by Daichi Kamada (Lazio).
67' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Luis Alberto is replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
67' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.

65' Luis Alberto (Lazio) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Pietro Terracciano makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
65' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) for Nicolo Rovella.
62' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Matteo Marcenaro who sees an offensive foul.
62' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) replaces Giacomo Bonaventura.
62' Substitution. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) on for Lucas Beltran.
60' Booking. Maurizio Sarri (Lazio) receives a caution from the referee.
59' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
58' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Pietro Terracciano keeps it out with an amazing save.
58' What a big chance! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
57' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Matteo Marcenaro shows the yellow card to Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) for a heavy challenge.
54' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
53' A cross from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
50' The ball is behind the sideline. Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes a throw-in.
48' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) brings his opponent down. Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Luis Alberto (Lazio) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort low towards the middle of the goal and Pietro Terracciano easily makes the save.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincenzo Italiano probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alfred Duncan. He is replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45+2' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
43' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) probably handled the ball.
42' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Luis Alberto (Lazio) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
40' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Matteo Marcenaro didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

37' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Ivan Provedel guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
36' Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul after Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
35' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
34' The ball has crossed the sideline. Fiorentina are taking a throw-in.
33' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
31' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marcenaro after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
29' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
28' Good movement by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
26' The game is interrupted. Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
26' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) sends a chip pass into the box, but Ivan Provedel is quickest to intercept the ball.

24' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marcenaro with no other option than to blow for a foul.
23' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
22' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
21' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
18' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) jumps into a tackle and Matteo Marcenaro signals a foul.
17' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the right post. What a great chance!
17' The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.
15' Celebrations are cut short for Fiorentina as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
13' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
12' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Luis Alberto (Lazio) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
11' It's a nice effort by Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Ivan Provedel. Easy save.
11' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
11' Now Fiorentina have a corner. Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play.
8' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
7' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
6' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
2' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will take a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marcenaro.
